fields.headline: Notice of a data incident affecting a research study
fields.from: Office of Research Compliance, Marston State University
whatHappened: Ransomware encrypted two instrument computers on the research network.
Research IT isolated the network at 07:40 and began restoring from backup.
dataInvolved: Participant study identifiers and test scores.
No names, addresses or payment data were stored on these computers.
whatWeAreDoing: Restoring the computers from clean backups.
Reviewing whether any data left the network.
whatYouCanDo: Contact the study team with questions.
Report anything unusual about study messages to the IRB office.
